nodes.name: sample_memory_trace
nodes.summary: Minimal fixture representing a single Temporal MemoryRecord with actor/action/target fields and an empty metadata map. Used in tests that exercise the MemoryStore read/write round-trip and SHA-256 integrity verification paths. Carries a fixed UUID so tests can assert deterministic record identity.

nodes.name: sample_perception_input
nodes.summary: Fixture for a single Text-modality perception event produced by PerceptionAdapter. Contains source, modality, raw data payload, and a pre-computed meaning field to verify downstream semantic extraction. Used in tests that validate schema validation, PCA decorrelation stubs, and modality dispatch logic.

nodes.name: sample_procedural_policy
nodes.summary: FSM policy fixture defining a single state transition from 'Start' to 'Observe' with a trigger condition, effect label, version counter, and zero reward signal. Exercises ProceduralCache FSM transition logic and checkpoint save/load; the zero reward provides a baseline for reward-shaping tests.

nodes.name: sample_reflexion_snapshot
nodes.summary: Fixture capturing an AureusBridge reflexion snapshot linking a chain-of-thought trace (two reasoning steps) to an outcome label and a numeric feedback score of 0.9. References a temporal trace record by UUID, enabling integration tests that validate the reflexion-to-temporal linkage and feedback ingestion pipeline.

nodes.name: sample_symbolic_node
nodes.summary: Fixture for a single SymbolicStore graph node carrying dual labels ('Concept', 'Example'), a confidence weight, and a freeform metadata map. Used to verify node insertion, label-based LRU cache lookup, and weight-based ranking in SymbolicStore tests against both the petgraph and sled backends.

nodes.name: sample_temporal_event
nodes.summary: Fixture representing a raw temporal event as ingested by TemporalIndexer, containing a timestamped content string, agent tags, a trigger type, and a floating-point weight. Acts as the canonical seed record referenced by the reflexion snapshot fixture and used in segmented ring-buffer and Markov-ordering tests.
